question: Drafts for @Bisal_File2Link_Bot (https://t.me/Bisal_File2Link_Bot, '4Gb File To Link / Streaming Bot'), @DirectURLBot (https://t.me/DirectURLBot, 'FILE TO LINK') and @LinkXGenBot (https://t.me/LinkXGenBot, link expires after 24 Hrs) were refused as duplicates of debrid/telegram-file2link-bot. Are they added as their own records?
why: Each is a different Telegram bot with its own t.me page and its own stated offer; none is the 20MB-limit @file2link_bot, whose record is unchanged and correct (fails-quota, any-phone). The match was made on the shared t.me host or the 'file to link' title, so the entity grouping needs a per-bot override and each draft needs its own record.
